title: Qualify bounded precision and interval research oracles
commitMessage: docs: qualify M7 precision and interval research oracles

contribution.summary: Qualify M7-W01-C01-T1 as a bounded research Q/O/D: compare exact BigInteger cancellation against binary64, prove one rational 1/10 enclosure from adjacent IEEE 754 doubles, and screen provider strategies. Keep M7/W01/C01 active and T2 planned. No new precision/interval API, provider, package, public release or sibling integration.
contribution.value: Supply two independently hand-checkable BCL numeric reference cases, Q/O/D admission notes and an explicit managed/native provider cost and qualification matrix. Distinguish calculation precision, arithmetic enclosure and physical measurement uncertainty. Record the oracle execution only after DWF runs, leaving provider adoption/deferral for T2.
debtChanges: Arbitrary real precision and certified interval evaluation remain unadmitted; do not imply they exist from exact BigInteger witnesses.
One adjacent-double enclosure of 1/10 is not a general outward-rounding guarantee or a statistical/physical uncertainty bound.
Candidate managed and native providers require exact source/version, license/notices, TFM/RID and offline runtime inspection.
Before any public precision API: bound memory/time/operation domains, cancellation, overflow and independent consumer oracles.
M7-W01-C01-T2, C01, W01 and M7 remain unfinished; completed spike research is not delivered product functionality.
contribution.nextAction: On durable RS106 success, prepare T2 to admit a bounded provider contract only with independent source/version/license/RID/rounding and consumer qualification, or explicitly defer with trigger. Preserve the existing Math exact contracts and unapproved external/public boundaries.

achievements.achievement: Fix the accepted precision research question, existing exact-rational baseline and two independently falsifiable finite numerical oracles.
Execute BCL-only exact cancellation and adjacent-double 1/10 enclosure checks; record a bounded candidate-provider cost and evidence screen.
Defer unqualified high-precision/interval providers while admitting only exact research fixtures, owner gates and T2 decision criteria.
Complete the research Q/O/D with exact oracle evidence and a provider matrix, without claiming any new scientific runtime capability.
